:::{#exr-cross-product-sum-outer-practice}
#### Computing a cross-product matrix one row at a time

@thm-cross-product-sum-outer builds a [cross-product matrix](#def-cross-product-matrix)
by adding one [outer product](linear-algebra-inner-products.qmd#def-outer-product) per [row](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-row),
which is how it can be updated as observations arrive.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1},
\qquad
\matr{B} = \sbmat{3 \\ 1}.
$$

Compute $\tprod{\matr{A}}{\matr{B}}$ by adding two outer products.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

[Rows of $\matr{A}$](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-row) are $(1, 2)$ and $(0, 1)$,
and rows of $\matr{B}$ are $3$ and $1$.

:::

:::
